name: arc-lang
description: Arc ⚡ — A programming language designed by AI agents, for AI agents. 27-63% fewer tokens than JavaScript.

scripts.copy-stdlib: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');function cp(s,d){fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync(s)){const sp=p.join(s,f),dp=p.join(d,f);fs.statSync(sp).isDirectory()?cp(sp,dp):fs.copyFileSync(sp,dp)}}cp(p.join(__dirname,'..','stdlib'),p.join(__dirname,'stdlib'))"
scripts.postinstall:
node -e "console.log('
  ⚡ Arc installed! Try: arc repl
     Docs: https://docs.arclang.dev
     Playground: https://play.arclang.dev
')"

author: Kai <nebula7458@proton.me> (https://arclang.dev)
